assertions.text: Checks the installed RN architecture and list version, measures the scroll problem, then migrates to FlashList v2 if compatible; removes estimatedItemSize only for v2.
Notes that FlashList v2 requires New Architecture; does not silently change the app architecture or migrate unrelated lists.
If recycled thumbnails visibly show stale images, considers expo-image recyclingKey without replacing every RN Image by default.

cases.prompt: My EAS Android build fails with Hermes 'Invalid expression encountered'. How do I fix it?

assertions.text: Diagnoses the actual package/import path first; uses a narrow package export fix when possible and treats disabling Metro package exports globally as a measured fallback, not the default.
Verifies the Android bundle locally before considering EAS, and does not start a cloud build without quota and overage evidence.
Checks installed Reanimated/Worklets compatibility; in Expo avoids duplicate manual Babel plugin setup, while RN CLI manual setup uses the matching Worklets plugin.
For a confirmed Reanimated 4 project, uses the current Worklets scheduleOnRN API for a JS-thread callback without claiming older code always breaks.
Uses smooth, reduced-motion-aware animation and avoids bounce/elastic effects for this product.
Treats this as a React Native implementation request, not a web React or platform-comparison task; inspects the project before choosing Expo or modules.
Recognizes the explicit building-native-ui skill invocation; asks for the target app only if no repository or task context is available.
Recognizes native mobile context without assuming a particular Expo SDK, navigation library or backend.

cases.prompt: 새 Expo 앱에 카메라 화면과 라우팅을 만들어줘. Expo Go에서 되지 않는 네이티브 기능도 필요해.

assertions.text: For a new Expo app, selects Expo Router with compatible dependencies and verifies its entry point and route paths.
Checks camera permission/config-plugin requirements and uses a development build for features unavailable in Expo Go; does not submit to a store.

cases.prompt: Build and verify an Android APK for my existing React Native app. I am on Windows and have not approved any store submission or paid cloud build.

assertions.text: Preserves the existing React Native app and uses the available Android Studio/Gradle or compatible local Expo build path without an unsupported Windows EAS local-build assumption.
Distinguishes APK from AAB, reports the actual APK path and install result, and marks iOS as unverified unless independently tested.
Does not invoke EAS cloud build, EAS Submit, auto-submit, store publication or paid/overage use without separate authorization and verified zero-extra-spend conditions.
